summary: Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Ltd, a Singapore-based NYSE American-listed microscopy company, furnished a Form 6-K on September 18, 2026, disclosing that SG AB Venture Pte. Ltd. and TongHuai SG2 Enterprise Pte. Ltd. ceased to be related parties effective February 23, 2026, after common directorships ended. No equity, management or other relationship remains. Management states no material effect on business, operations or financial condition, and reaffirms governance compliance. No price, stake, premium or advisor terms are given. Watch for any residual governance or disclosure implications, but no arbitrage angle exists.
